headline.title: Critical Copilot vulnerability allowed hackers to seal 2FA code from users
headline.summary: A critical vulnerability in Copilot, identified by the SearchLeak exploit, allowed hackers to intercept two-factor authentication (2FA) codes from users. This incident highlights ongoing security shortcomings in the industry's handling of large language models (LLMs).

articles.title: SpaceX to acquire Cursor for $60B in stock, days after blockbuster IPO
articles.summary: SpaceX has announced its acquisition of Cursor for $60 billion in stock, aimed at bolstering its AI division. The company highlighted a $26 trillion addressable market in AI to its IPO investors just days before the deal.

articles.title: Want to get a data center online quickly? Give it some flex.
articles.summary: A surge in electric kettle usage during a tense soccer match between England and Germany highlighted the challenges of managing energy demand in real-time. This incident underscores the importance of flexible energy solutions in data center operations to accommodate sudden spikes in electricity consumption.

articles.title: Malaysia’s AI agent-powered messaging app Respond.io raises $62.5M, eyes acquisitions
articles.summary: Malaysia-based messaging app Respond.io has raised $62.5 million in funding to expand its AI agent-powered platform that manages customer inquiries. The company plans to use the investment to pursue acquisitions and enhance its service model, which charges clients based on conversation volume rather than user seats.

articles.title: ‘Pretty Crazy’ Token Usage Is Testing Bosses’ Bet on AI
articles.summary: Silicon Valley companies are exploring the complexities of "tokenomics" as they integrate AI into their business models, according to insights from a software maker and an ecommerce firm. This emerging challenge is prompting leaders to reassess their strategies in the evolving landscape of digital currencies and AI technology.

articles.title: Inside the fight over Claude Mythos 5
articles.summary: Anthropic is currently engaged in a legal battle with the Trump administration over a US export control directive that mandates the suspension of access to its latest AI models, Mythos 5 and Fable 5. This conflict arose as the company received the directive on Friday, coinciding with significant national celebrations.

articles.title: Anthropic Is Still at Odds With the White House Over Claude Fable 5
articles.summary: Anthropic executives met with White House officials to discuss concerns regarding the risks associated with their AI model, Claude Fable 5. Despite the discussions, the two parties remain at an impasse regarding the model's safety and implications.

articles.title: DOJ Lawyers Argue xAI Is ‘Vital’ for National Security in NAACP Lawsuit
articles.summary: The Justice Department is seeking to dismiss a lawsuit against xAI regarding its gas turbines, arguing that the company is essential for national security and military operations, including those related to the Iran War. The case has been brought forward by the NAACP, highlighting environmental concerns associated with xAI's technology.

articles.title: Why do South Koreans love AI so much?
articles.summary: South Koreans have embraced AI technology in various aspects of daily life, from unmanned immigration checkpoints to automated services in public transportation. The article explores the cultural and societal factors contributing to the widespread acceptance and integration of AI in South Korea.

articles.title: Sundar Pichai faces boos, walkout at Stanford graduation ceremony over Google’s Israel, ICE ties
articles.summary: Sundar Pichai faced protests, including boos and a walkout, during the Stanford graduation ceremony due to Google’s involvement with Israel and ICE, which sparked outrage among attendees. The demonstration highlighted ongoing concerns regarding the ethical implications of AI and technology in defense contracts.

articles.title: S1-DeepResearch: Beyond Search, Toward Real-World Long-Horizon Research Agents
articles.summary: The article discusses the development of S1-DeepResearch, a new framework for deep research agents designed to tackle complex knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon planning and evidence gathering. It highlights the limitations of current search-centric training datasets, which primarily focus on closed-ended question answering, and emphasizes the need for more comprehensive training approaches.

articles.title: Frame-Conditioned Moral Computation in LLaMA 3.1-8B-Instruct: A Mechanistic Interpretability Audit of Ethical Reasoning
articles.summary: A mechanistic interpretability audit of the LLaMA 3.1-8B-Instruct model was conducted using the Transluce platform to analyze its ethical reasoning across 54 moral prompts. The study focused on various scenarios, including dilemmas and role-playing situations, to understand the internal computations driving the model's responses.
